summary: An earlier conversation about a strained marriage matters when the couple considers separating.
realLife: When Eleanor Roosevelt learned of Franklin’s affair with Lucy Mercer, she offered him a divorce. Franklin chose to stay married and promised Eleanor he would stop seeing Mercer.
inGame: needs: a prior conversation outcome read by the separation scene.

turns.what: The couple recalls the earlier argument and agrees to try the change they discussed then.
turns.pulledBy: Both still want to stay together and the practical option remains available.
turns.writesBack: A new household agreement follows the earlier conversation.

turns.what: One spouse remembers promising to be home on hearing nights. The other asks about the weekends they never discussed.
turns.pulledBy: The earlier conversation covered evenings in session and the new calendar adds Saturday meetings.
turns.writesBack: The couple carries the weekend question into their next conversation.
